title: Parkio Daily for August 8, 2026
teaser: Mickey's Not-So-Scary Halloween Party kicked off last night with heavy crowds; interactive Ewok companion lands at Disneyland August 13.

rides.note: Party crowds thin out Friday mornings; ride early

bignews.title: Mickey's Not-So-Scary Halloween Party debuts with sold-out crowds
bignews.body: The first night of Mickey's Not-So-Scary Halloween Party drew heavy crowds across Magic Kingdom. The after-hours event runs select nights through fall with new entertainment, parade characters, and exclusive snacks.

parkioInsight.text: Party nights tend to draw guests into Magic Kingdom all day, even before the 7pm event start. Plan major attractions for morning hours or consider other parks on sold-out party dates.

bignews.title: Interactive Ewok companion launches at Disneyland August 13
bignews.body: Starting August 13, Droid Depot at Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge will sell an interactive Ewok plush that responds to droids and park elements. The Batuu Adventure Buddies collection mirrors the earlier Pal Mickey concept from two decades ago.

parkioInsight.text: Limited-edition interactive merchandise often sells out within days at Galaxy's Edge. Stop at Droid Depot early on August 13 if you want one before stock runs low.

bignews.title: Captain Jack's Buccaneer Bash debuts at Halloween Party
bignews.body: A new live stage show featuring Captain Jack Sparrow launched at Mickey's Not-So-Scary Halloween Party in Adventureland. The pirate-themed entertainment replaces Jack's previous meet-and-greet format.

parkioInsight.text: New entertainment tends to draw crowds during the first few weeks of a party season. Catch the Buccaneer Bash early in the evening before Adventureland fills up for the parade.

bignews.title: Powerline Max show moves to roaming stage format
bignews.body: Max Goof's Powerline-inspired dance party has shifted from a Main Street pre-parade to a roaming stage show at Mickey's Not-So-Scary Halloween Party. The change adjusts crowd flow compared to last year's event.

parkioInsight.text: The roaming format means the show may appear at different times and locations. Check the party guide or ask a cast member for the latest schedule to avoid missing it.

topstories.title: Three Magic Kingdom attractions get Halloween overlays
topstories.body: Space Mountain, Mad Tea Party, and Monsters Inc. Laugh Floor are running special Halloween effects and themes during party nights. The overlays are exclusive to ticketed Halloween Party guests.

parkioInsight.text: Ride overlays tend to draw longer waits than usual during party hours. Tackle Space Mountain early in the event window, typically before the parade starts at 9pm.

topstories.title: Stitch's Masquerade Mashup show opens in Tomorrowland
topstories.body: A new Tomorrowland stage show brings Stitch, Lilo, and Angel to Rockettower Plaza for a masquerade-themed performance during Mickey's Not-So-Scary Halloween Party. The show runs multiple times per night.

parkioInsight.text: Tomorrowland entertainment tends to pull crowds away from attractions nearby. Use show times as a window to ride Space Mountain or Buzz Lightyear with shorter waits.

topstories.title: Disney's Not-So-Spooky Spectacular returns with Jack Skellington puppet
topstories.body: The nighttime fireworks show at Mickey's Not-So-Scary Halloween Party features a life-size Jack Skellington puppet and projections across Cinderella Castle. The show runs at the end of each party night.

parkioInsight.text: Fireworks viewing spots along Main Street and the hub fill up 30–45 minutes before showtime. Secure your spot early or watch from Frontierland for lighter crowds and a side view.

topstories.title: Exclusive Halloween merchandise debuts at Magic Kingdom
topstories.body: New Loungefly bags, Minnie ears, and party-exclusive items launched for Mickey's Not-So-Scary Halloween Party. The collection is available only during party nights at select Magic Kingdom shops.

parkioInsight.text: Party-exclusive merch often sells out before the night ends, especially Loungefly items. Shop Main Street or Frontier Trading Post in the first hour if you want popular designs.

topstories.title: Six Ravens restaurant now serving at Disney Springs
topstories.body: Six Ravens, a new table-service restaurant at Disney Springs, has opened with a full menu. Early reviews highlight the casual atmosphere and variety of entrees.

parkioInsight.text: New Disney Springs restaurants tend to have easier walk-up availability in the first few weeks. Try visiting for lunch or an early dinner before word spreads and reservations tighten.

topstories.title: Grand Floridian parking expansion clears water-management approval
topstories.body: A 3.6-acre expansion project at Disney's Grand Floridian Resort has received permit approval from water-management authorities. The project will add parking capacity to the flagship resort.

parkioInsight.text: Resort construction projects often bring noise and equipment traffic during daytime hours. Guests staying at Grand Floridian may want to plan off-site activities mid-morning through early afternoon.

topstories.title: PhotoPass adds new seasonal photo opportunities
topstories.body: Magic Kingdom has added fall-themed PhotoPass backdrops and Magic Shots for the season. The new options are available to all guests with park admission.

parkioInsight.text: PhotoPass lines tend to grow longest mid-afternoon when families stop for portraits. Visit popular photo spots in the first or last hour of the day for quicker service.

icymi.title: Ale & Compass breakfast menu revamped at Yacht Club
icymi.body: The breakfast menu at Ale & Compass restaurant in Disney's Yacht Club Resort has changed, with new entrees and updated pricing. The updates affect both weekday and weekend service.

icymi.title: Hallmark Christmas movie filmed at Disney World gets release date
icymi.body: Hallmark's first-ever Christmas movie shot at Walt Disney World, titled Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True, has announced its debut date. The film features Magic Kingdom and other park locations.

icymi.title: Universal Orlando expands Christmas celebration to Epic Universe
icymi.body: Universal Orlando announced an earlier start to its 2026 Christmas season, with festivities expanding into Epic Universe's Celestial Park and Ministry of Magic areas. The season begins in mid-November.

icymi.title: Spaceship Earth TV series ordered for Disney+
icymi.body: Disney+ has ordered a pilot for a television series inspired by EPCOT's Spaceship Earth attraction. The show joins a growing slate of Disney parks-themed content on the streaming platform.

spotlight.title: New Halloween party snacks debut across Magic Kingdom
spotlight.body: Pecos Bill, Pinocchio Village Haus, and The Lunching Pad are serving exclusive Halloween-themed desserts and entrees during Mickey's Not-So-Scary Halloween Party. Items include a fudgy cookie, a $6 dessert, and a limited-time burger. Most snacks are available only to party ticketholders.

parkioInsight.text: Party-exclusive food tends to sell out later in the evening as word spreads. Hit quick-service locations in Tomorrowland or Fantasyland within the first 90 minutes of the event for best selection.
